title: Tier Reductions on Replacement Award Holds under the Free Night Awards Member Terms
content:
| Ashbury Rewards tier currently held | Tier reduction |
|---|---|
| Ashbury Rewards Titanium Elite | 3000 points (upper replacement tier reduction) |
| Ashbury Rewards Ambassador Elite | 3000 points (upper replacement tier reduction) |
| Ashbury Rewards Gold Elite | 1500 points (lower replacement tier reduction) |
| Ashbury Rewards Platinum Elite | 1500 points (lower replacement tier reduction) |
| Ashbury Rewards Silver Elite | None |
| Ashbury Rewards Member | None |

These are the tier reductions on the replacement's night price when a member applies a replacement among the Free Night Awards to a night of a Reward Night Rate reservation. The tier reduction is the upper replacement tier reduction for a Titanium Elite or Ambassador Elite member, the lower replacement tier reduction for a Gold Elite or Platinum Elite member, and nothing for every other member. It is taken off the replacement's night price once.

The tier is the one the membership record shows as currently held.
